purpose: Owner-authorized, benchmark-scoped canonical HABB brand package (Brand Identity, Snapshot, Core V1, Memory V1.1) produced through the real Branding governance. Inputs are authoritative; outputs are derived and verified by scripts/build-benchmark-brand-package.mjs.

evidence.statement: HABB is a personalized-gifts and UV-printing shop with a physical retail shop at Rue de Bruxelles 18, 5000 Namur and a Shopify online store; phone cases can be personalized in the shop in about 5 minutes, depending on model availability.
Positioning is premium-but-accessible: personalized gifts that look premium but are not expensive; the visual and brand identity is deliberately sober and credible.

Brand rules: premium, sober, credible. Explicitly forbidden: generic AI-generated rendering look, fake gold effects, artificial warm glow gradients, heavy unrealistic shadows, decorative branches and hearts unless asked. Confirmed colours: navy 0f2a52 / 183247, terracotta c0392b / c56e54, cream fbf8f3, sand efe9e1.

Visual rules: never alter a customer face; preserve the exact proportions of real products; no unnecessary decorative hearts or branches (owner clarification 2026-08-26); print assets are checked before production.

HABB is a local personalisation studio and concept store: personalised gifts and emotional keepsakes, useful everyday objects such as tumblers, express phone-case personalisation, curated lifestyle tech and premium gift presentation. It should not be positioned as a discount or generic gadget shop.

Approved or established brand ideas include "HABB Store n’est pas une simple boutique. C’est une signature." and "Vos souvenirs. Votre création. Prêt chez HABB à Namur."; the commercial meaning is that HABB transforms photos, names, messages and memories into gifts that carry a story.

Differentiators: physical shop in central Namur, personalisation made locally on site, human help with photo, text and layout, an express case-personalisation kiosk, one destination for personalised gifts, tumblers, gift boxes and selected lifestyle tech, premium presentation. HABB checks customer files and may contact the customer or provide a preview.
HABB works with UV and UV-DTF methods.

The owner lists the needs HABB serves: a thoughtful last-minute gift, a unique gift carrying a photo, name, date, message, logo or QR code, a memorial object, an attractive ready-to-offer gift, a practical object made personal, a locally made gift with assistance.
Approved service description GBP-PROD-01: "La personnalisation est réalisée en boutique en environ 5 minutes, selon la disponibilité du modèle." and "Coque + personnalisation : 25 €."

The owner approved the HABB expression system for Benchmark 001: realistic and credible photography, the real product authoritative, editorial composition with breathing room, no automatic decorative hearts or leaves, no artificial gold, glow or generic AI look.
The owner approved the strategic content of the canonical Brand Core V1 (category, buying contexts, value proposition, positioning, core promise, reasons to believe, personality, voice, exclusions).

The owner approved the initial digital colour tokens navy #183247, terracotta #C56E54, cream #FBF8F3 and white #FFFFFF, no beige or sand default, and left typography empty until an exact font pair is approved with licence evidence.
The knowledge base gives a working reference retail price of 24.90 EUR for the personalised-case offer and asks to confirm in Shopify before quoting.

A search of the HABB project folders and downloads found no file holding the HABB Master Reference (18 July 2026) or the HABB Design Manual v1.0 / Design Bible Foundation v1, and no competitor or customer-review research; those sources were therefore not cited.

principles: realistic and credible product photography
natural or controlled studio lighting
soft directional light rather than flat lighting
materials and textures must look real
the product must remain immediately identifiable
images must not have a generic AI-generated look
do: use clean, sober backgrounds
use realistic stone, marble, studio or physical surfaces only when relevant
preserve natural shadows and believable depth
keep lighting coherent across product and scene
preserve sufficient contrast between product and background
dont: beige as a generic AI-style default
decorative leaves or foliage added automatically

principles: the real HABB product is authoritative
the creative adapts to the product, never the opposite
real dimensions, proportions and distinctive details must be preserved
personalisation must remain visible and readable
the product is the hero of the composition
do: preserve original product pixels whenever possible
prefer cut-out and compositing over product regeneration
generate or compose the environment around the product
add realistic shadow/reflection only when it does not alter the product
allow controlled relighting only when product colours remain truthful
show enough of the product to understand immediately what is being sold
dont: regenerate a real product when the real asset exists
change phone-case cut-outs, buttons, camera holes, shape, proportions or material
modify a face appearing in a customer's personalisation/photo
distort a person's face, body or identity

principles: editorial composition rather than generic advertising-template composition
strong visual breathing room
immediately understandable hierarchy
product dominance
simple does not mean empty
premium does not mean decorated
do: reserve text space before generating or composing the environment
use negative space intentionally
create one clear focal point
balance product, text and environment
allow asymmetry when it strengthens the composition
preserve clear space around the product
dont: add ornaments only to make the design feel premium

principles: layout is built around the product and the message
hierarchy must be clear
alignments must be intentional
margins and spacing must feel generous
product and text must never collide
price and primary promise must remain readable
do: reserve safe text areas
respect the placement/channel facts supplied by Marketing
trigger re-layout when text does not fit
keep spacing rhythm coherent
dont: shrink text below minimum readable size
place a headline over an essential part of the product
use the exact same placement for every creative
turn all HABB content into one repetitive template

principles: illustration is secondary
illustration must never compensate for a weak product asset
illustration must remain simple and relevant
do: allow illustration only when explicitly required by the creative concept
allow illustration when it is itself part of the customer's personalisation

principles: functional before decorative
simple
coherent
immediately readable
do: use icons only when they materially improve comprehension
keep a clean, geometric and consistent icon style
dont: generic icon collections used as decoration
stars, crowns, diamonds or badges to simulate premium

principles: motion must be useful, not demonstrative
product identity must remain stable
pacing should feel modern and controlled
motion serves comprehension
do: product reveal
subtle zoom
believable camera movement
limited typographic animation
clean transitions
dont: effects that look like an AI demo
